user.title: Connect to SmartHome Core
user.description: Enter Core's URL. Leave the manual token empty to pair using Core's existing HA access, then approve the connection. An existing manual Core credential remains supported. Speech platforms connect to the SmartHome speech service on port 8773 by default; disable them to use other Home Assistant engines.

data.speech_url: Speech service URL (optional; defaults to Core host on port 8773)

persona.title: Choose a persona
persona.description: Select the persona this SmartHome Assistant agent will use. Home Assistant continues to own wake word and pipeline selection.

pairing.title: Approve SmartHome Core pairing
pairing.description: Connect to {core_url}, Core identity {core_id}? {replacement} Approving saves a new credential automatically. The persona affects wording only. HTTP connections rely on your trusted home network; use HTTPS on untrusted networks.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure SmartHome Core
reconfigure.description: Update the Core connection, timer mappings, and optional speech service URL. Leave the manual token empty to pair again; approval replaces Core's previous automatic credential.

data.speech_url: Speech service URL (optional; defaults to Core host on port 8773)

reconfigure_persona.title: Choose a persona
reconfigure_persona.description: Select the persona this SmartHome Assistant agent will use. Home Assistant continues to own wake word and pipeline selection.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Core. Check its URL and availability.
error.unsupported_protocol: Core does not support protocol version 1.
error.invalid_speech_settings: Speech service URL must be a valid HTTP(S) URL without credentials.
error.invalid_persona: Choose a persona offered by Core or keep the saved persona.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing could not start. Check that Core uses the same HA instance and an administrator HA_TOKEN. If CORE_HA_AGENT_TOKEN is set, enter that manual token or clear it and restart Core. An abandoned pairing can take five minutes to expire.
error.pairing_incomplete: Pairing was not confirmed. No assistant action was started. Submit again to check this pairing, or start a new flow after it expires.
error.invalid_timer_outputs: Map assist_satellite entities to unique esphome actions ending in _smarthome_timer_exchange_v1. Finish or cancel active timers before changing their timer output mapping.

abort.pairing_expired: This pairing request expired or was cancelled. Start setup again.

init.title: Persona, speech, timer outputs, and sidebar
init.description: Choose whether SmartHome supplies STT and TTS engines, and whether its jobs panel appears in the sidebar. Enhanced timer mappings select compatible acknowledged EchoMuse exchange actions.

data.speech_url: Speech service URL (optional; defaults to Core host on port 8773)
